text: Close your eyes and bring to mind the Devi in today's alankaram.
Meditate quietly for a few moments, then join your hands and bow.
Meditate on Rajarajeswari, Mother of the worlds.
The verse means: We bow to Rajarajeswari, the supreme Shakti worshipped in many forms — Uma, Parvati, Kali, Bhairavi.
